design_en: Big Ash Dreg, a heavy stocky cartoon ash-stone brute: a hunched, round, bear-like body with a huge smooth grey-brown round belly; the back, shoulders and top of the head are covered by thick overlapping stone-ash plates with glowing orange lava cracks; two angry glowing orange eyes under a heavy brow; a wide frowning mouth with two white tusks pointing up from the lower jaw; two thick stubby stone arms with blocky fists hanging at the sides; two short thick legs with clawed stone toes. Thick dark brown-black outline, 2-tone cel shading.
